probed: Krita 5.3.3, 2026-10-13: one 40 px stroke per preset, pressure 0.9, orange over a blue|tan ground, measured and inspected by eye. A preset not listed here was not probed.

cards.a) Eraser Circle: erases with a hard round edge
cards.a) Eraser Small: erases a thin hard line about half the size
cards.a) Eraser Soft: erases with a soft feathered edge
cards.b) Airbrush Soft: very soft edges, slightly translucent: glows, soft gradients, haze
cards.b) Basic-1: hard round, fully opaque flat colour
cards.b) Basic-2 Opacity: opaque round with slightly soft edge; pressure lowers opacity
cards.b) Basic-4 Flow Opacity: round, about 85% opaque: builds up in layers
cards.b) Basic-5 Size: hard round line about 80% of size; pressure thins it
cards.b) Basic-6 Details: crisp, opaque, flat-ended, about 80% of size: details and edges
cards.c) Pencil 1 Sketch (mypaint): MyPaint: about 4x the requested size, cloudy blob
cards.c) Pencil 2b (mypaint): MyPaint: about 1.6x size, lumpy soft blob
cards.c) Pencil-4 Soft: grainy pencil shading at half opacity
cards.c) Pencil-5 Tilted: hairline unless the pen is tilted; nearly invisible
cards.d) Ink pen (mypaint): tapered ink line: thick start, thinner tail
cards.d) Ink-2 Fineliner: crisp hard round, opaque: clean edges and lines
cards.d) Ink-3 Gpen: crisp hard round, opaque: clean edges and lines
cards.d) Ink-7 Brush Rough: opaque round with a dry-brush start
cards.d) Ink-8 Sumi-e: splits into several thin parallel dry streaks
cards.e) Marker Dry: flat sharp-edged band about half the size, opaque
cards.e) Marker Plain (mypaint): translucent flat band with soft ends: glazes
cards.f) Bristles-1 Details: opaque bristle streaks along the stroke with split ends
cards.f) Bristles-2 Flat Rough: flat streaky bristle band with split edges
cards.f) Bristles-3 Large Smooth: smooth opaque bristle band, ragged ends: painterly coverage
cards.f) Bristles-4 Glaze: narrow opaque band (about 55% of size) with fine streaks, despite its name
cards.f) Bristles-5 Flat: thin tapered streaky band, partly transparent
cards.f) Charcoal Rock Soft: opaque band with rough grainy edges
cards.g) Dry Bristles: dry-brush streaks with broken coverage: scumbling
cards.g) Dry Brushing: thin dry streaks, half the size
cards.g) Dry Textured Creases: opaque band with crease texture and a dry end
cards.h) Chalk Grainy: opaque core with speckled grainy edges
cards.h) Charcoal Pencil Medium: grainy charcoal band with rough edges
cards.h) Charcoal Pencil Thin: grainy charcoal band with rough edges (same as Medium at 40 px)
cards.h) Charcoal pencil large: grainy charcoal band with rough edges (same as Medium at 40 px)
cards.i) Wet Bristles: opaque bristle band about 60% of size with fine streaks
cards.i) Wet Circle: opaque round that drags the colour beneath at its start
cards.i) Wet Knife Plus (mypaint): opaque flat-ended band with crisp ends
cards.i) Wet Paint: soft feathered edges; drags the colour beneath at its start. As many small dabs it reads washed out and grainy
cards.i) Wet Paint Details: like Wet Paint, a little tighter
cards.i) Wet Paint Plus (mypaint): opaque round; picks up the colour beneath at its start
cards.i) Wet Smear: opaque round with a smeared start
cards.i) Wet Textured Soft: soft, streaky and translucent: textured glazes
cards.j) Waterpaint Hard Edges: translucent wash with a darker rim
cards.k) Blender Basic: no colour: smudges existing paint along the stroke
cards.k) Blender Blur: no colour: softens existing edges where it passes
cards.k) Blender Knife Edge: no colour: drags a crisp thin sliver of existing paint
cards.k) Blender Pixelize: no visible effect on flat paint
cards.k) Blender Rake: no colour: rakes existing paint into parallel streaks
cards.k) Blender Smear: no colour: strong smear that pulls paint along
cards.l) Adjust Color: tints the paint beneath toward the colour, soft
cards.l) Adjust Dodge: brightens the paint beneath toward pale yellow, soft: lights and glints
cards.l) Adjust Multiply: darkens the paint beneath, soft: shadows
cards.l) Adjust Overlay Burn: overlay: raises contrast and saturation, soft
cards.m) RGBA 01 Thick-dry: dry impasto with a woven grid texture
cards.m) RGBA 02 Thickpaint: opaque thick paint with ridge streaks
cards.m) RGBA 04 Impasto: broken embossed dabs with their own colour shifts
cards.m) RGBA 06 Rock: narrow band with darker embossed edges
cards.memileo 01 Brush - Flat Tip: flat opaque brush with streaks and a feathered start
cards.memileo 02 Knife - Wavy Ridges: palette knife: opaque with embossed wavy ridges
cards.memileo 03 Knife - Grainy Grooves: palette knife with grooves and ragged edges
cards.memileo 04 Knife - Grainy Edge: palette knife: opaque with grainy edges
cards.memileo 05 Knife - Detail: palette knife: opaque with subtle embossing
cards.memileo 06 Knife - Flow: palette knife with embossed flow marks
cards.memileo 07 Knife - Flow Blender: no colour: knife texture pressed into existing paint
cards.memileo 08 Knife - Flat Smooth: palette knife; shifts the colour darker and drips on the lower edge
cards.memileo 09 Knife - Flat Rough: opaque flat palette knife with rough edges
cards.t) Shapes Fill: nothing in a stroke (fills closed shapes)
cards.t) Shapes Square: scattered rectangles spilling far outside the stroke
cards.v) Clone Tool: needs a clone source; otherwise smears
cards.v) Distort Grow: liquify; no visible effect in a straight stroke
cards.v) Distort Move: liquify; no visible effect in a straight stroke
cards.v) Distort Shrink: liquify; no visible effect in a straight stroke
cards.v) Sketching-3 Leaky: flat opaque band with hard square ends
cards.v) Texture Impressionism: scattered multicoloured dabs that ignore the chosen colour
cards.w) Texture Normal Map: paints normal-map purple whatever the colour
cards.x) Filter Blur: filter brush: softens existing detail; no effect on flat paint
cards.x) Filter Sharpen: filter brush: sharpens existing detail; no effect on flat paint
cards.y) Texture Hair: parallel thin strands along the stroke: hair
cards.y) Texture Spray: wide spray of specks spilling well past the stroke: falling snow, dust
cards.y) Texture Wood Fiber: fine parallel translucent fibres: wood grain
cards.z) Stamp Hearts: multicoloured hearts that ignore the chosen colour
cards.z) Stamp Shoujo Bubbles: coloured rings that ignore the chosen colour
